/make-friends-online.heading: Make friends online for free, one conversation at a time
paragraphs: Meetly is a browser-based place for adults to meet new people through one-to-one text and video chat. There are no public follower counts or profiles to build. Google sign-in is required before matching, but your Google name and email are not displayed to your partner. Start with text if you want to get comfortable before sharing your voice or camera.

Choose interests you actually want to discuss: a game you are learning, a film you enjoyed, or a hobby you would like to try. A shared tag gives you a useful opening, but matching depends on who is available. You may have to wait, and a language or interest match is not guaranteed.

/make-friends-online.heading: A practical first conversation
paragraphs: Try a question with an easy answer: 'What have you been watching lately?' Follow up on one detail rather than moving straight to a new question. If your partner mentions a favourite film, ask what they liked about it. You do not need to share your workplace, address, phone number or private social accounts to have a good conversation.

Friendship usually takes repeated, mutual effort; a random match does not guarantee a lasting friend. A short, friendly conversation can still be worthwhile. Use Next for a different match, Leave when you are finished, and Report or Block for unwanted conduct. Adults-only rules and sign-in do not guarantee that a stranger is safe.

/chat-with-strangers.heading: Talk to strangers online using text or video
paragraphs: Meetly lets adults start a one-to-one conversation in their browser without downloading an app. Sign in with Google, confirm that you are 18 or older, choose text or video, and look for a match. Text mode needs no camera or microphone. In video mode, your browser can request permissions during matching, and media can connect automatically after both people enter the room.

Use a language you are comfortable speaking and add a few interests if you want a starting topic. Available participants determine the match. Meetly does not promise an instant connection, a particular country, or that every partner will share your interests.

/chat-with-strangers.heading: What to say and when to leave
paragraphs: A simple opener such as 'What is a hobby you could talk about for hours?' gives the other person room to answer. Keep the conversation mutual: respond to their answer and let them ask a question too. You can politely end a conversation without exchanging contact details or agreeing to another call.

Leave and report if someone pressures you for money, intimate images, private information or contact outside the site. Nudity, sexual content, threats and harassment are prohibited. Google sign-in does not verify someone's age, and automated screening can make mistakes. Direct WebRTC calls can disclose your public IP address, and another participant can record their screen.
